notable_absence.finding: Unlike the n1ql/n1ql-language-reference statement pages for CREATE INDEX and CREATE PRIMARY INDEX (which carry a Prerequisites table naming Write/Query Index privileges keyed to cluster access credential type), this guide page shows no privilege table at all for either the SQL++ tab or any SDK tab. Access-control is documented once, at the statement-reference level, not restated on the task-oriented guide.

cross_component_finding: This guide is almost entirely a reuse layer over vocabulary already fully modeled by round 5's n1ql/ statement sweep and the cloud/indexes/ index-taxonomy sweep (primary/secondary/composite/partial/covering/array/metadata index types all map 1:1 onto existing index-type:* and n1ql:* concepts with no new index-type semantics introduced). The one genuinely new structural element is the per-language SDK interface (IQueryIndexManager/QueryIndexManager), which the SQL++-only reference pages never mention - the guide's actual contribution is exposing a task-level 'how do I do this without SQL++' surface, not new domain concepts.
cross_product_finding: Confirms the registry's cluster-access-credential-type/privilege-table id already established for CREATE INDEX/CREATE PRIMARY INDEX (createindex.json, createprimaryindex.json) is not restated on the guide, unlike, e.g., the n1ql reference pages which show it directly - consistent with treating guides as task wrappers, not access-control authorities.
